description.zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en:
The personal access token.
This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AK/SK pair or STS temporary authorization.

description.zh: 创建人阿里云账号ID，支持多个，以逗号分隔
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the creators. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

description.zh:
截止创建时间


> ISO 8601格式，如2019-03-15T08:00:00Z，大小比较为 "小于"


> 创建时间范围：[createdBefore, createdAfter)，即左闭右开区间
description.en:
The end of the creation time range.


> ISO 8601 format, such as 2019-03-15T08:00:00Z. The comparison is "less than".


> The creation time range is [createdBefore, createdAfter), which is a left-closed, right-open interval.

description.zh:
起始创建时间

> ISO 8601格式，如2019-03-15T08:00:00Z，大小比较为 "大于等于"
description.en:
The start of the creation time range.

> ISO 8601 format, such as 2019-03-15T08:00:00Z. The comparison is "greater than or equal to".

description.zh:
该字段主要用于过滤新旧版本的合并请求，默认不过滤，同时获取新旧版本的内容，若是一直使用新版合并请求，可忽略该参数。可选值：
- new：仅查询新版合并请求
- old：仅查询旧版合并请求
description.en:
Filters merge requests by version. By default, no filtering is applied and both new and legacy merge requests are returned. If you have always used the new merge request version, you can ignore this parameter. Valid values:
- new: queries only new merge requests.
- old: queries only legacy merge requests.

description.zh: 代码组ID，支持多个ID，以逗号分隔
description.en: The code group IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

description.zh: 类标ID列表，多个ID以逗号分隔
description.en: The label IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

description.zh:
排序字段，默认值为updated_at
- created_at：创建时间
- updated_at：更新时间

若传入其他无效字符，默认使用updated_at
description.en:
The field by which to sort results. Default value: updated_at. Valid values:
- created_at: creation time.
- updated_at: update time.

If an invalid value is passed, updated_at is used by default.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The organization ID, in string format. You can obtain this ID from the Yunxiao access URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/<OrganizationId>.

description.zh: 页码，默认值为1，从第1页开始
description.en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1.

description.zh: 每页大小，默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 代码库ID，支持多个ID，以逗号分隔
description.en: The repository IDs. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

description.zh: 评审人阿里云账号ID，支持多个，以逗号分隔
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the reviewers. Multiple IDs are separated by commas.

description.zh: 搜索关键字，匹配合并请求的标题
description.en: The search keyword. Matches against the merge request title.

description.zh:
排序方式，默认值为desc
- desc：降序
- asc：升序
description.en:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:
- desc: descending order.
- asc: ascending order.

description.zh:
合并请求状态，默认查询所有状态
- opened：已开启，包含评审中、待合并、待开发状态
- closed：已关闭
- merged：已合并
- all：所有，若是all，可以不用传值；其他无效字符，也默认查询所有。
description.en:
The merge request state. By default, merge requests in all states are queried. Valid values:
- opened: open, including the under review, to be merged, and under development states.
- closed: closed.
- merged: merged.
- all: all states. If the value is all, you do not need to pass this parameter. Other invalid characters also default to querying all states.

descriptions.zh: 该接口需要确保当前企业已经在使用新版MR，具体可看当前企业的合并请求页面是否已是新版本。
descriptions.en: This operation requires that the current organization has adopted the new merge request (MR) version. Check whether the merge request page of the current organization uses the new version.
